The underside of the arch glows orange for about ten minutes after sunrise. Bring a wide lens and patience.
Notes
0.5 mi loop from the lot. 20+ photographers most mornings — be there 60 min before sunrise. Starburst at f/16 as the sun clears the La Sals.
